ArtSource.description: Existing art to preview a frame on: a draft's render, or a sample's.
ArtSource.title: ArtSource

AutoCheck.description: What auto-moderation found for the current image. ``passed`` recorded the moderator's approval.
AutoCheck.title: AutoCheck

BioRecord.description: The bio written for this card: its template and model, the text, and every attempt.
BioRecord.title: BioRecord

BioRef.description: The reviewed bio template (and model) that wrote the card's bio (see :mod:`argus_mint.bios`).
BioRef.title: BioRef

BioTemplate.description: One version of a bio template, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
BioTemplate.title: BioTemplate

Capabilities.description: What this server will do. A client disables a control whose capability is false.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CardDraft.description: Everything needed to publish a card, except the pins and the signature.
CardDraft.title: CardDraft

CardStyle.description: The owner's styling of a framed card: any colours, so be it if that's black on black.
CardStyle.title: CardStyle

ChallengeRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/challenge: the owner asks for the message to sign.

``action: review`` with ``approve``; ``action: edit`` with the exact ``edit`` it will authorise.
ChallengeRequest.title: ChallengeRequest

CreateDraft.description:
POST /drafts. The template, frame and bio are named by id and version, never by path.

Either render (``variables``, ``seed``, optionally ``model``), or take a pre-rendered
``library`` entry, whose variables, seed and checkpoint then apply.
CreateDraft.title: CreateDraft

Edit.description: A change to the card's text, which redraws the card image on the same art.
Edit.title: Edit

EditTextRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/edit: only the owner edits, with the signed challenge for exactly this edit.

The moderator approves or rejects; they don't change the card.
EditTextRequest.title: EditTextRequest

Frame.description: One version of a frame, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
Frame.title: Frame

FramePreviewRequest.description: POST /frames/{id}/{version}/preview: a frame (any status) on existing art; returns a PNG.
FramePreviewRequest.title: FramePreviewRequest

FrameRef.description: The reviewed frame composited onto the render (see :mod:`argus_mint.frames`).
FrameRef.title: FrameRef

LayoutRequest.description: POST /frames/{id}/{version}/layout: where these texts go, for a browser preview.
LayoutRequest.title: LayoutRequest

LibraryListing.description: GET /library: pre-rendered portraits, for drafts without a GPU (``CreateDraft.library``).
LibraryListing.title: LibraryListing

LoraChoice.description: A render's pick from the template's ``lora_options``. ``weight`` defaults to the first allowed.
LoraChoice.title: LoraChoice

LoraOption.description:
A LoRA a card may choose (reviewed with the template), at one of its allowed weights.

``models``: the checkpoints it may pair with (a LoRA belongs to one family); empty means any
the template allows.
LoraOption.title: LoraOption

LoraRef.description:
A LoRA by file name, with its weight and the trigger words the renderer appends.

A bare string in YAML means ``{name: <string>, weight: 1.0}``.
LoraRef.title: LoraRef

RenderRequest.description: Everything a renderer needs, fully determined by template version + values + seed.
RenderRequest.title: RenderRequest

ReviewRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/review.

The moderator sends ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` and ``by``; the owner sends the
signed challenge (``message`` + ``signature``), and ``by`` is their address.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

SampleRequest.description: POST /samples: render sample cards of a template (any status) for its reviewer.
SampleRequest.title: SampleRequest

Sampling.description: Sampler settings, fixed by the reviewed template so a render is reproducible.
Sampling.title: Sampling

SlotBackground.description: A filled, rounded box behind a text slot.
SlotBackground.title: SlotBackground

SlotStyle.description: How one text slot is drawn. Unset fields keep the frame's own choices.
SlotStyle.title: SlotStyle

Template.description: One version of a render template, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
Template.title: Template

TextEdit.description:
The owner's change to the card: text and style. ``None`` leaves a field as it is; an empty
slot text clears it; ``style`` replaces the whole style (an empty one clears it).
TextEdit.title: TextEdit

TextSlot.description:
A box for one piece of card text.

The text is drawn at ``size`` if it fits, else at the largest size down to ``min_size``
that fits; with ``wrap`` it breaks across lines. If it doesn't fit even at ``min_size``,
it is clipped and ends in an ellipsis.
TextSlot.title: TextSlot

Tint.description: Recolour the frame overlay: every pixel moves toward ``colour`` at its own brightness.
Tint.title: Tint
